source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Navigate banking regulation,bank-class applicability and depositor provisions

payload.title: Identify the banking entity before applying a provision
payload.core_explanation_md:
The Banking Regulation Act index covers permitted business,organisation,licensing,reserves,advances,inspection,directions,reconstruction and specified depositor-related provisions. Applicability to different bank forms and the cooperative modifications must be checked rather than assuming every clause applies identically to every entity called a bank.

For a practical issue,identify the legal bank class and the exact power or obligation. Nomination,beneficial succession and payment/discharge questions are distinct; an index heading does not resolve every ownership dispute. Use the dated full text and relevant directions,particularly where later banking-law amendments affect the exam session.

self_check.prompt_text: Why identify the bank class first?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The applicable provisions and modifications can differ.

payload.stem_md: A cooperative-bank question is answered by copying a banking-company provision without checking the modification framework. What is missing?

options.text_md: The bank-class applicability and cooperative modifications
options.explanation_md: The entity form affects the legal analysis.
It does not establish all applicability.

options.text_md: A rule that all banks are ordinary firms

options.explanation_md: It does not determine the bank statute.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The entity form affects the legal analysis.

payload.stem_md: A nomination heading is treated as conclusive resolution of every beneficial-ownership dispute. What is required?

options.text_md: No further analysis because a heading is complete law
A rule that nomination never has any effect
The operative nomination,discharge and succession rules for the facts
options.explanation_md: Different legal questions must be distinguished.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Different legal questions must be distinguished.
